notes.title: Update 1.05 - Bug fix & crashes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We did a bunch of small updates to fix small issues here and there (wrong sprites, typos, blue is different from green etc...) but some players faced performance issues or even crash. We are very sorry about that and are on the bridge to fix those problems!

The problem was cause by two different things:
- The VSync: it's now deactivated no matter your setup.
- The loading between main menu and game scene: I split the resources to avoid loading unnecessarily ones from the other scenes. It should speed up the loading as well as fixing the crash.
You will see a 1.8GB update but it's not, resources have just been moved and the size of the game itself doesn't change, they are just spread differently.

!!! : I did this update very fast so it may cause side effects. I already spotted some tooltips not appearing in free mode because of that. We will fix them during all the weekend.

[b]Please continue sending your feedback and bug in the Discussion thread to help us making the game better. Sorry again about the disagreement![/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1716170/discussions/

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41045667/e1faa6849abbc8ed9f1dc061dac8d4dd42e07378.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone, 
Today we have a major update that touch every part of the game!
We didn't added any content but reworked some menus and the structure to create and release the first demo of the game!

[b]The demo includes:[/b]
- Features and object of v0.32
- All the Visual Novel part of Part 1
- The beginning of the Sex part of Part 1 allowing you to reach, if you are good, rank B.
- Free Mode to play as you want with Zoey. Objects available depends your rank.
- Gallery with the beginning of Zoey's comic by Erebeta.

You can download it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1716170/Zoey_My_Hentai_Sex_Doll/

Regarding the update itself:
[b]WHAT'S NEW?[/b]
[i]Intro & Main Menu[/i]
- NEW > New Intro with Zoey, the previous was old and very simple.

- NEW > Light particles on Main Menu to pimp it a little

- NEW > The Gallery arrives with 3 sections including Zoey's comics by Erebeta! Finish Episode 1 to unlock it as well as drafts we made for the game and "good moments" spent with Zoey. We will add more in the Gallery and the complete comics will be available to all Patrons directly in the game when it's finished!

- NEW > Game Over in VN parts, take care!

- BUG > Rollover on episodes was inconsistent. Fixed.

[i]Sex part[/i]
- NEW > Dust particle at the beginning

- NEW > I added a little DEBUG tool at the top right corner click on it to see the number of the current dialogue to easily report bugs.

- BUG > Changing the hair color of Zoey was making the pink color to bug. Fixed.

- BUG > Some typos and return to line. Fixed.

[i]VN Part[/i]
- NEW > Reworked the debug tool, now available on the top right corner with a button. We deleted the debug lines at the top center.

- BUG > Some players experienced a bug with the VN part making the choices impossible to click. Fixed.

[b]ABOUT RANKS[/b]
Last update, I integrated the rank system in the story. Better you performed with Zoey, highest is your rank (from C to S+). This system is now also be used in the FREE MODE. Each customization or actions now request a rank to be unlocked.

I will probably tweak the values and ranks later so don't hesitate to give me your feedback.
Remember that you can use the cheat code to grant you a S rank.
